images.alt: A traveler choosing a shaded route beside a cooling library during a Korean heatwave
images.caption: Use official alerts to choose shade, cooling stops, and safer travel hours.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off prompt. Image role: hero route-decision context. Use case: photorealistic-natural. Bright humid summer morning in an unbranded Korean urban riverside setting. One foreign visitor in light clothing and a brimmed hat pauses at a physical map board with a water bottle, choosing between an exposed sunlit path and a shaded path toward a public library. Wide editorial photograph, realistic hard summer light and humid haze, strong shade-sun contrast. Recent-image avoidance: avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, and cafe-table phone scenes. No phone, luggage, cafe, readable text, pseudo-writing, logos, brands, medical drama, or watermark.

images.alt: A wordless heat-safety decision flow from official alert to shade, cooling, water, rest, and emergency response
images.caption: Check the alert, route, cooling stops, hydration, rest, and emergency threshold.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off prompt. Image role: inline process and emergency decision flow. Use case: infographic-diagram. Completely wordless left-to-right heatwave flow on warm white: weather-warning beacon; forked exposed red path versus shaded teal path; public library with snowflake symbol; water bottle and seated rest figure; final branch contrasting a conscious tired person cooling in shade with an unconscious silhouette and emergency phone symbol. Polished flat editorial illustration, coral amber teal navy, five stages with arrows. Recent-image avoidance: do not make this a second hero and avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage, skyline, and cafe-table compositions. No words, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, brands, app UI, graphic injury, tiny labels, or watermark.
